title: Best Free AI Coding Assistants 2026: Tested Picks & Real-World Reviews
description: Compare the 6 best free AI coding assistants in 2026: GitHub Copilot Free, Cursor Free, Codeium, Tabnine Free, Cody Free, and Continue. Real limits, verified.
short_desc: GitHub Copilot Free vs Cursor Free vs Codeium vs Tabnine Free vs Cody Free vs Continue — real 2026 free-tier limits and honest verdict.
tldr_pick: GitHub Copilot Free is the best free AI coding assistant in 2026 — 2,000 code completions per month, GPT-4o powered chat, and native VS Code and JetBrains integration. For an AI-native IDE experience, try Cursor Free with 2,000 completions plus 50 slow premium requests.
key_takeaways: GitHub Copilot Free and Cursor Free are the two strongest free tiers in 2026 — both offer 2,000 completions per month and GPT-4o-class chat.
Codeium is the best fully-free option with unlimited completions for individuals — no monthly cap, just slower inference on busy days.
Tabnine Free runs entirely on-device for the basic plan — the only tool here that never sends your code to a vendor server.
All paid tiers ($10-20/mo) remove the request caps and unlock GPT-5 and Claude Opus 4.5 class models.
who_for: Solo developers, students, and hobbyists who want real AI coding help without paying $10-20/mo for a paid plan. Also relevant for working developers who want to evaluate AI tools before getting their employer to pay for a team plan.
methodology: We aggregated 2026 reviews from dev.to, Hacker News, and each vendor's docs, then verified every free-tier limit against the vendor's pricing page this month. This is an editorial roundup, not a hands-on benchmark — every tool is genuinely free to install and try. Where a 'free tier' was effectively unusable (e.g. 100 requests/month), we say so.

faq.q: What is the best free AI coding assistant in 2026?
faq.a: GitHub Copilot Free is the strongest general-purpose pick — 2,000 completions per month, GPT-4o chat, and native VS Code integration. If you want unlimited completions, Codeium is the only option here with no monthly cap.

faq.q: Are these AI coding assistants really free?
faq.a: Yes — every tool on this list has a free tier with no credit card required. The catches: most cap completions or chat messages per month, and the free chat models are usually a step below the paid GPT-5 and Claude Opus 4.5 class models.

faq.q: Can I use free AI coding assistants at work?
faq.a: Yes, but check your company's policy on AI tools. Copilot, Cursor, and Cody all have enterprise plans with admin controls and audit logs. Tabnine is the only one with a fully self-hosted option for strict compliance environments.

faq.q: Do free AI coding assistants train on my code?
faq.a: By default, most do — but every tool on this list has a setting to opt out. Copilot: GitHub settings page. Cursor: Privacy settings. Codeium: account-level toggle. Tabnine Free never sends your code anywhere because it runs on-device.

faq.q: Should I pay for a coding assistant in 2026?
faq.a: If you code 4+ hours per day, yes — the $10-20/mo paid tiers remove the request caps and unlock GPT-5 and Claude Opus 4.5 class models. The free tiers are designed to be enough for occasional use, not daily heavy use.
